leadership.name: Mr. M Sudarsan Swamy
leadership.bio: Mr. Sudarsan Swamy graduated with M.S. from Florida International University & worked in US for 7 years before returning to India.He is in various businesses spanning over 42 years across hospitality, poultry, seafood and currently in the renewable energy business as MD – SM Renergy (P) Limited operating pan India and in Dubai - SMR Energy Systems LLC., specializing in Solar business.He have served at several government organizations during this period, some of the positions held: Marine Products Export Development Authority – Ministry of Commerce – GoI National Fisheries Development Board - Ministry of Agriculture – GoI Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture – Ministry of Agriculture –GoI Consultant: Shrimp Hatcheries to the United Nations – Food & Agriculture Organization – Rome.

leadership.name: Mr.K V Krishna Kumar
